validation.summary: The candidate provides a strong structural foundation with accurate typography, colors, and sticky positioning. However, critical animations fail to execute (Hero cards remain invisible, SVG lines do not draw), and a required UI mockup is missing, significantly impacting visual and animation fidelity.
strengths: Excellent use of Tailwind configuration for design tokens.
Sticky positioning in the Clinical Support section works well.
Typography and color palette closely match the reference.

issues.title: Hero UI Cards are Invisible
issues.observed: The UI cards in the right column of the Hero section are completely invisible because the `@keyframes slideUpFade` is not generated by Tailwind's JIT compiler (the class `animate-slide-up` is never used in the HTML).
issues.expected: The UI cards should slide up and fade in sequentially on load.
issues.fix_instructions: Move the `@keyframes slideUpFade` definition into the standard `<style>` block in the `<head>`, OR apply the `animate-slide-up` class directly to the card elements and use inline `style="animation-delay: Xms;"` so Tailwind generates the required CSS.

issues.title: Platform Features Mockup Missing
issues.observed: The right column of the Platform Features section contains a generic placeholder box with text.
issues.expected: The right column should contain a high-fidelity HTML/CSS representation of the UI dashboard shown in the video.
issues.fix_instructions: Replace the placeholder box with a constructed HTML/CSS UI mockup resembling the dashboard in the reference video (e.g., a simple layout with a sidebar, header, and mock content rows).

issues.title: SVG Lines Animation Fails to Render
issues.observed: The converging SVG lines in the Problem/Solution section remain hidden. The scroll-based JavaScript calculation is likely failing to update the `stroke-dashoffset` correctly.
issues.expected: The lines should draw in visibly as the user scrolls or when the section enters the viewport.
issues.fix_instructions: Refactor the animation logic. Instead of brittle scroll-position math, use an `IntersectionObserver` to detect when the section is in view, and apply a CSS class that transitions `stroke-dashoffset` to 0 over a set duration (e.g., `transition: stroke-dashoffset 1.5s ease-in-out;`).

issues.title: Clinical Support List Spacing is Too Large
issues.observed: The terms in the Clinical Support left column are spaced very far apart using `space-y-24`, creating excessive empty space.
issues.expected: The terms should form a more compact list as seen in the video.
issues.fix_instructions: Reduce the vertical spacing between the terms (e.g., change `space-y-24` to `space-y-8` or `space-y-12`) and adjust the container's vertical padding to ensure the right column still has enough scroll distance to demonstrate its sticky behavior.

patch_instructions: Add `@keyframes slideUpFade { 0% { opacity: 0; transform: translateY(40px); } 100% { opacity: 1; transform: translateY(0); } }` to the `<style>` block to fix the Hero animation.
Build a static HTML/CSS UI dashboard mockup for the right column of the Platform Features section to replace the placeholder.
Rewrite the SVG line drawing script to use `IntersectionObserver`. Set the initial `stroke-dashoffset` via JS, and when intersecting, set it to `0` with a CSS transition applied to the paths.
Change `space-y-24` to `space-y-12` in the Clinical Support left column.
